Source: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-review/pull/1#discussion_r4248463280

**🎯 Functional Correctness** | **🟠 Major** | **⚡ Quick win**

**Do not mark review bodies with outside-diff findings as `informational`.**

The pattern `actionable comments posted:` classifies every CodeRabbit review body as `informational`. Only the markers in Line 5 override that result: `potential issue`, `_nitpick_`, `![x-priority]` and `severity:`.

CodeRabbit review bodies also carry findings in other forms:
- "Outside diff range comments" entries with `_🛠️ Refactor suggestion_ | _🟠 Major_`.
- "🧹 Nitpick comments (N)" sections. This text does not match `_nitpick_`.

Such a body is imported with verdict `informational`. `evaluateRound` checks only for `pending` items, so the round completes without a decision on those findings. The retrieved learning states that out-of-diff findings live in the review body.

Add the actionable markers to the Line 5 override.

<details>
<summary>🐛 Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
--- "a/src/findings.ts"
+++ "b/src/findings.ts"
@@ -2,7 +2,7 @@
 
 /** Recognize bot noise that provides context without requesting a code change. */
 export function isInformational(body: string): boolean {
-  if (/(?:^|[\s_*])potential issue(?:$|[\s_*])|_nitpick_|!\[(?:high|medium|low)[-_]priority\]|\bseverity\s*[:=]\s*(?:critical|high|medium|low|major|minor)\b/iu.test(body)) return false;
+  if (/(?:^|[\s_*])potential issue(?:$|[\s_*])|_nitpick_|nitpick comments \(\d+\)|refactor suggestion|outside diff range comments \(\d+\)|_\s*[🔴🟠🟡]\s*(?:critical|major|minor)_|!\[(?:high|medium|low)[-_]priority\]|\bseverity\s*[:=]\s*(?:critical|high|medium|low|major|minor)\b/iu.test(body)) return false;
   return /rate[- ]limit|quota (?:exceeded|exhausted)|trial (?:has )?ended|review failed|failed to (?:review|generate)|full review finished|walkthrough|no actionable (?:comments|issues)|actionable comments posted:|review skipped|summary of (?:changes|pull request)|review budget|does not receive automatic reviews|reviewer's guide/i.test(body);
 }
 
```
</details>

Based on learnings: "Comments referencing lines outside the diff's changed ranges are attached to the review body itself, not a line-level thread, so also parse review body text for actionable findings."
